_comment: Fire elemental, normal tier (2026-07-21): a high-band burn hazard on par with the Z2 front. curveLevel 18 sits it at ArmySoldier/front difficulty — dangerous but below the Orc elite. Carries FireElementalAura (shared with the greater elemental). Drops FireWard @0.2 — the drop pair authored against its own source (the mob that burns you drops the fire resist), Antivenom/spider precedent; this is also what finally gives FireWard a world unlock source, closing the last reachability gap. Slow (0.55) — it advances, it doesn't chase. PO places spawns in the editor. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
